nature: AI-generated original high-resolution sources with soft alpha; NOT hand-placed native pixel art. Fictional crops, not botanical or historical evidence.

assets.layout: 4 columns (sprout, juvenile, bud, mature) x 3 rows (bluebell, orange_blossom, chime_herb); 362px cells
3x3, 426x410 cells; row1 bluebell/orange_blossom/chime_herb, row2 matching *_seed packets, row3 blue_dye/sugar/garden_cookie

integration: Byte-for-byte copies (sha256 equal to sources); no pixel edits, no Python/Pillow image editing. scripts/flower_art.gd crops a fixed square window per cell and resizes in Godot to 32x32 with INTERPOLATE_NEAREST, cached per sprite (same pipeline as bakery_art.gd). Godot import: lossless (compress/mode=0), no mipmaps.
alpha_measurement: Per-cell alpha (>16) bounds verified inside each crop window with clear gutters (no petal cut, no neighbour leakage). Opaque interiors are alpha ~249-253, not 255. Source has broad faint haze (alpha 1-31). At 32px the growth sprites keep ~200-340 ghost pixels at alpha 1-7 (visually invisible) and 9-50 fringe pixels at alpha 8-63 per sprite; icons 27-151 ghost / 2-25 fringe. See work/flowers/art-check/displayed-alpha-audit.json.
status: Native 32px gallery reviewed (work/flowers/art-check). Acceptable as a display-only adapter; native pixel validation remains PENDING: soft alpha edges, near-opaque interiors and nearest downsampling of non-native sources mean this is not production-certified pixel art. In-world review on real tiles/UI not yet done.
